rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server that integrates with the addTaskManager iOS/macOS app through CloudKit, implementing the ADD (Assess-Decide-Do) framework created by Dragos Roua. The implementation enforces strict realm-based restrictions where tasks and projects can only be created/edited in the Assess realm, assigned contexts and due dates in the Decide realm, and marked complete in the Do realm. Built with production-ready CloudKit Web Services integration including Apple ID authentication, session management, and comprehensive security features, it provides AI assistants with structured access to personal productivity data while maintaining the cognitive load management principles of the ADD framework.
